notes.title: We're going to be at SupaNova Gold Coast this weekend!
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

Ever wanted to meet one of the creators of GBDNATE in person? Well now you can! I'm Lach and I'm the writer of GBDNATE, and I'll be at the Lached Up Games stall at Supanova on the Gold Coast!

We'll be selling exclusive GBDNATE posters at Supanova as well as art prints and posters from my new game, Max's Big Bust. We'll even sign your stuff for free too, just ask!

You can find us at Booth 9 in the Artist Alley, and for more information on Supanova check out their website here: http://www.supanova.com.au/

If you live in Australia swing on by, it's going to be a great weekend! And don't worry if you miss us, we're going to be at Supanova Sydney on June 17th-19th too.

Cheers :)
Lach

notes.title: Steam Trading Cards Released!
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

Due to popular demand, we've now added Steam Trading Cards to Gender Bender DNA Twister Extreme! There's 6 cards to collect, as well as 4 different backgrounds and 5 emoticons.

For more information about Steam Trading Cards check the FAQ here: https://steamcommunity.com/tradingcards/faq

Enjoy the game!

~ Lach

notes.title: Final Two Characters Released!
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

We've just uploaded the final two character routes to Steam, bringing the total number of playable characters up to thirteen! This will be our final story update to the game, but we will be fixing any bugs or typos that pop up.

Thanks again for everyone for being so supportive throughout this whole journey, we couldn't have done it without you!

Cheers :)
Lach

notes.title: Scarlett Now Released!
notes.content:
Hey everyone, we've just updated Character #11 to Steam! Only two left!

Scarlett is a puzzle focused route like Russell, and even though we've done some testing there's probably a few bugs we've missed here and there. If you find anything, send us an email at gbdnate@gmail.com and we'll get it fixed.

Have fun with the new route!

Cheers :)
Lach

notes.title: Max's Big Bust - New Gender Bender Game on Kickstarter
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

Some of you might already be aware of this, but I've launched a Kickstarter for the next game I'm writing, 'Max's Big Bust - A Captain Nekorai Tale'. The game has a gender bender theme, an anime art style and fully animated cutscenes. 

It's going to be a massive game that I hope you all love, and you can check out the project here: https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/336712504/maxs-big-bust-a-captain-nekorai-tale

If you've got any questions, let me know!

Cheers :)
Lach

notes.title: Aleanne Now Available!
notes.content:
Hey everyone! We've just uploaded Aleanne, our 10th character to Steam. The route has two love interests, three endings, and a bunch of romance. It's another one of our routes based on an Indiegogo backer, and we're really proud of what we came up with by working with them.

We're still in Early Access, and while we've run our own bugtesting and QA on this end, there's a good chance we've missed a few bugs or spelling errors. If you do find something, you can post a message here or send me an email at gbdnate@gmail.com and I'll fix it ASAP.

Hopefully you all really enjoy the route! 

Cheers :)
Lach

notes.title: Russell Route Released!
notes.content:
Just a heads up, the 9th GBDNATE character is now available to play! Unlike the other routes, Russell has a big focus on puzzle solving and exploration, and is completely different to anything we've done before.

Let us know what you think! Production on Aleanne is already underway, and we've still got a few characters left after that.

Cheers :)
DK and Lach

notes.title: GBDNATE's 8th character story, Nadine is now available
notes.content:
Gender Bender DNA Twister Extreme's 8th character story has been added to the game. 

Nathan took a real gamble when he hired Derek and Liam. But he had faith that they could come up with something really awesome to make him rich!

He was right about one thing. They did come up with something really awesome. Shame he got caught up in it though. Now he has to deal with his new body, his upcoming marriage, and some legal trouble he'd rather go without!
